The Skye Collection tune index

A searchable index of all 546 tunes in Keith Norman MacDonald’s The Skye Collection of Best Reels and Strathspeys (1887) — the Highland fiddle repertoire that became a cornerstone of Scottish and Cape Breton fiddling. Sort by number to browse it in order, and open any tune for the book’s own setting with playback.

308 tunes link to their page on thesession.org, where many go by other names — those are shown under the title.
